# aiempire-chatter

> AI chatter for a creator's Fanvue account (AI Empire course). A Cloudflare Worker reads fan messages every minute, answers in character with human-like timing through an uncensored LLM on RunPod (tool calling), remembers each fan, sells locked pay-to-view photos from the vault and generates new photos on demand with the creator's Krea 2 LoRA on RunPod. The owner controls everything from a private Telegram bot. Every member self-hosts: one Telegram bot, one Cloudflare Worker (free plan), two or three RunPod Serverless endpoints.

## Docs
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/docs/SETUP-GUIDE.md): step-by-step setup from zero, every click, values sheet, troubleshooting
- [README](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/README.md): overview, Telegram commands, how she sells, built-in rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for AI assistants: file map, commands, secrets, conventions, gotchas, how-tos
- [Architecture](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): request paths, conversation state machine, data model, selling, photo pipeline, safety layers
- [Fanvue API notes](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/docs/FANVUE-API-NOTES.md): OAuth, chats, media upload, webhooks, quirks
- [Image prompt rules](https://github.com/justlinuxnoob/aiempire-chatter/blob/main/docs/image-prompt-rules.md): how her photo prompts are written; request format of the image endpoints
